question:
**Direction: Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.**

__Shall you pass__ me that pasta bowl?
solution:
The correct answer is **'​Can you pass****.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence needs improvement in the part **"Shall you pass."**
 
• Let us see the usage of the given modal verbs:​
 
 
• Shall: We use "shall" to make predictions and to state facts about the future. 
 
 
• Example: *We shall__ never forget the holiday we had in Vietnam.*
 
 
 
• *​*Can: We use "can" to talk about the ability to do something at a specific time in the present or future.
 __
 
• Example: *I can__ see you.*
 
 
 
• Could: When "could" is used as the past tense of "can", it refers to an ability that a person generally had in the past or to something that was generally possible in the past.
 __
 
• Example: *When I was younger, I could__ run for miles.*
 
 
 
 
 
• ​As the sentence is talking about the ability to pass her that pasta bowl, so we must use **"can"** in this sentence.
 
• The structure of an interrogative sentence with **"can"** is --->>> **Can + Subject + V1 + Object?**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 ​

Correct sentence:* **__**Can you pass**__ me that pasts bowl?*
